## HEADNOTE
Sample Consumer Protection Act, 2010, Section 3 - warranty - a manufacturer must repair or replace a defective product within the warranty period.
## FACTS
The appellant bought a washing machine that failed within four months. The manufacturer offered only a paid repair.
## ARGUMENTS
The manufacturer argued that its warranty card excluded replacement. The appellant relied on Section 3.
## REASONING
Section 3 of the Sample Consumer Protection Act, 2010 implies a duty to repair or replace goods that are defective during the warranty period. A warranty card cannot contract out of a statutory duty.
## HOLDING
The manufacturer must replace the machine or refund its price. Terms excluding replacement during the warranty period are unenforceable.
